people/bixel: bixel built the kahu-tok language. the work began in the early generations after the first descent, when the survivors who had carried the bastard tongue down out of the bunkers needed a shared speech that could grow with the new community.
people/hanna-miskinnis: hanna miskinnis discovered biological immortality. her research group, working in the years before the fracture, developed the telomere intervention that allowed the human body to halt the cellular aging process.
people/mara: mara did not found the zou-esh. the order existed before her, going back at least to the messengers of the age of tapestry who spread the legend of the mountain that breathes. what mara did was become the most famous and most prolific zou-esh on record.
people/ston: ston is named in the kahu record. the records currently available do not yet fix the role, the dates, or the era. this entry is a placeholder for the figure and will be expanded as records are recovered.
people/the-longs: the longs are the pre-collapse ultra-wealthy who monopolized the miskinnis longevity intervention in the years before the fracture. they are the immortal elite who took the technology that hanna miskinnis had refused to use and sealed themselves inside arcologies.
places/hart-ston: hart-ston is the active volcanic cone that sits within the caldera. the name in kahu-tok reads heart-stone. the cone is sacred to the kahu. it is also the source of the residual heat that keeps them alive.
places/hart-wata: hart-wata is the great lake at the center of tora vyl drak. the name in kahu-tok reads heart-water. it is the kahu's primary freshwater source and the geographic center of life inside the caldera.
places/hot-kasa: hot-kasa is the principal settlement of the kahu. the name in kahu-tok reads hot-house, the warmth. approximately one hundred and twenty thousand kahu live here, roughly forty-three percent of the total population.
places/nu-tera: nu-tera is the plateau that wraps the southern flank of tora vyl drak. the name in kahu-tok reads new-land. the plateau sits just above five thousand feet, on the safe side of the peli-shen spore line by a margin of dozens to hundreds of feet depending on the season and the year.
places/ol-tri-shen: ol-tri shen is the forest preserve at the heart of the wilds, the north quadrant of tora vyl drak. the name in kahu-tok reads old-tree life. it is the kahu's longest-running deliberate non-cultivation and the closest thing inside the caldera to ancient ecology.
places/sun-tera: sun-tera is the south quadrant of the caldera. the name in kahu-tok reads sun-land. it is the kahu's principal agricultural zone inside tora vyl drak proper and the source of most of the caldera's food.
places/the-gate: the gate is the chokepoint where the long climb tops out onto the nu-tera plateau. it is the only ascent path from the world below the spore line to the kahu sanctuary above. the long climb is narrow throughout and impassable in winter. the gate is where the climb ends and the plateau begins.
places/the-hearth: the hearth is the west quadrant of the caldera, the part of the basin nearest to the residual magma chamber beneath tora vyl drak. it holds the geothermal grid, the principal settlement of hot-kasa, and most of the kahu's industrial and infrastructure systems.
places/the-long-climb: the long climb is the narrow ascent path from the lowlands to the nu-tera plateau. it is the only land approach to tora vyl drak from the world below the peli-shen spore line. anyone who reaches the kahu reaches them by this route, the gate at its top, and the stone climb above that.
places/the-wilds: the wilds are the north quadrant of the caldera. the quadrant is mostly unsettled. it holds the ol-tri shen forest preserve and the kahu's principal contact with non-cultivated ecology inside the rim.
places/tora-vyl-drak: tora vyl drak is the eighteen-mile volcanic caldera in the cascade range that has been the kahu sanctuary since the first descent in 2283 ad. the name reads, in importance-first kahu-tok, hope, call, last: the hope of the last call. the kahu named it for what it is.
events/the-caldera-shudder: the caldera shudder is the violent subterranean seismic warning that struck beneath tora vyl drak in approximately 4525 ad, one hundred years before the present.
events/the-first-descent: the first descent is the event by which the kahu became the kahu.
events/the-fracture: the fracture is the event that ended the world before. on november 10, 2075, at approximately 07:33 utc, the combined nuclear arsenals of the united states, russia, and china executed humanity's final act of global coordination.
events/the-great-eruption: the great eruption is the geological event that formed tora vyl drak. it occurred in approximately 2133 ad, fifty-eight years after the fracture and the cascadia impact of 2075.
events/the-great-silence: the great silence is the kahu term for the global electromagnetic pulse that ended the age of electricity in the moments of the fracture. the silence happened in the same minutes as the impacts, on november 10, 2075.
events/the-leveling: the leveling is the event by which the surface survivors of the fracture took back from the longs the ability to ever rule the surface again.
events/the-schism: the schism is the unfolding theological and medical disagreement within the kahu about how much biological intervention is appropriate. it is the central live conflict of the present moment in tora vyl drak.
eras/age-of-bloom: the age of bloom is the twelve-hundred-year golden age of kahu civilization. it spans approximately 2700 to 3925 ad, from the end of the founding work of the tapestry through the long quiet stretch during which the kahu way of life reached its apex. nearly half of the kahu's recorded history is the bloom.
eras/age-of-endura: the age of endura is the modern era of the kahu. it began in approximately 3925 ad, when the age of bloom, the twelve-hundred-year golden age of kahu civilization, gave way to a longer and quieter time of strain. the kahu of the present, in 4625 ad, live seven hundred years into the age of endura.
eras/age-of-tapestry: the age of tapestry is the founding era of the kahu civilization. it spans approximately 2283 to 2700 ad, from the first descent into the caldera through the four centuries of construction, language-building, and institutional formation that produced the kahu world.
eras/the-dark-century: the dark century is the era between the fracture and the first descent. it spans approximately 2075 to 2283 ad, two hundred and eight years. it is the era before the kahu, the era during which the people who would become the kahu's ancestors survived underground, watched the surface, and waited.
concepts/kahu: kahu is the word for the kahu people, the inhabitants of tora vyl drak and the plateau of nu-tera. it is also the word for a kahu, a single community of any size from a family unit of ten to twelve people through a sub-community of fifty to sixty to the entire population of approximately two hundred and seventy-eight…
concepts/peli-shen: peli-shen is the fungus that has rendered the lowlands lethal. the name in kahu-tok reads danger-life. it is the reason the kahu live above five thousand feet.
concepts/the-cascade: the cascade is the volcanic arc that runs the length of what was, before the fracture, the pacific northwest of the united states and the canadian province of british columbia. the arc holds tora vyl drak. the kahu call the range the bones of the cascade or simply the cascade.
concepts/the-creeping-dark: the creeping dark is the kahu name for the slow neurotoxic descent caused by accumulating peli-shen exposure. it is what happens to the mind of a person who lives below five thousand feet.
concepts/the-five-filters-of-uniqueness: the five filters of uniqueness are the five conditions, geological and human, that together make tora vyl drak the only sanctuary of its kind on the post-fracture earth. each filter is necessary; none alone is sufficient. all five had to apply at the same place at the same time for a civilization to be possible.
concepts/the-great-devaluation: the great devaluation is the kahu term for the decades of institutional decay, information warfare, and environmental degradation that preceded the fracture. it is, in kahu reckoning, the world that broke before the world broke.
concepts/the-hyper-winter: the hyper-winter is the kahu term for the years of permanent twilight and freezing temperatures that followed the fracture. it is the climate condition that killed nine in ten of the impact survivors and that defined the conditions of the bunker survival from which the kahu's ancestors emerged.
concepts/warden: warden is the kahu's central decision-support system. it is a continent-scale biological supercomputer, realized during the age of bloom, that models the kahu's agriculture, infrastructure, ecology, demographics, and the long arc of consequences for the choices the kahu make.
organizations/the-cat-kahu: the cat-kahu are the kahu order responsible for the breeding, training, and stewardship of the kahu cats. they are a small lineage-based community living on the wrap-around of the nu-tera plateau, the northern shaded flank of tora vyl drak's rim.
organizations/the-council: the council is the central institutional structure of kahu governance. it is the body that deliberates on caldera-wide questions and integrates the recommendations of warden into kahu decision-making.
organizations/the-warden-tenders: the warden-tenders are the kahu order responsible for the living systems of tora vyl drak. they are an apothecary-priest hybrid. their work is upstream of every kahu decision that depends on biotech, ecological management, or the consultation of warden.
organizations/zou-esh: the zou-esh are the scholar-warrior order of the kahu. their work has two faces. they defend the gate, the chokepoint at the top of the long climb, against any incursion from below.
objects/air-klin: air-klin is the respiratory biome inoculation administered to zou-esh before deep or sustained operations below the peli-shen spore line. the name in kahu-tok reads clean-air or air-clean. it is part of the zou-esh's layered defenses against the fungus that has rendered the lowlands lethal.
objects/ston-shen: ston-shen is the chemosynthetic lichen-bacteria paste that sustained the kahu's ancestors through the dark century. the name in kahu-tok reads rock-life. it is the food that kept humanity alive during the long underground, between the failure of the bunker rations and the first descent into the caldera.
objects/the-zou-kit: the zou-kit is the standard field equipment of the zou-esh. the kit is the outward sign of the order. it is also the technological foundation that allows the order to operate below the peli-shen spore line and to defend the gate against threats arriving from there. the kit is entirely living cloth and biotech.
language/kahu: kahu is the foundational word of the kahu-tok language and of the kahu world. it means a community of people. it is used at every scale: the family unit of ten to twelve people, the larger sub-community of fifty to sixty, the entire population of approximately two hundred and seventy-eight thousand.
language/micasu: micasu is the kahu-tok word for welcome. it is one of the organic accretions to the language, words that entered the lexicon from the bunker populations the zou-esh brought home rather than from bixel's engineered core.
language/peli-shen: peli-shen is the kahu-tok word for the radiotrophic fungus that has rendered the post-fracture lowlands lethal. the literal reading of the compound is "danger-life," from peli (danger) and shen (life).
language/zou-esh: zou-esh is the kahu-tok word for the scholar-warrior order of the kahu. it is used both for the order collectively and, in the singular, for an individual member. "a zou-esh," "the zou-esh," and "the order" are all valid in english renderings; the kahu-tok form does not formally distinguish.
